title: Most Hessdalen residents report experiences

tellings.quote:
it was very easy to tell that an
[snorts] extremely high percentage of
people that lived there had experienced
things like
>> upwards of 80 85 90% of people

plain: In Hessdalen, a valley in Norway, a very large share of the people who live there say they have experienced something strange, upwards of 80, 85 or 90 percent of them. Michels says this from his own visit, where he found it "very easy to tell" how common the experiences were. If true, it would make the valley a place where odd events are a normal part of life rather than rare tales.
